definition-changed.answer: §2002:4 4.11: 'alphanumeric group item: Any group item except for' a strongly-typed, bit or national group item; 2023 3.11 adds the variable-length group, which needs dynamic-length items or dynamic-capacity tables that 2002 does not have. The implied record of GR5 is a plain group of the RECORD clause's maximum size in both, so the rule governs the same files.

behaviour-switch.answer: The switch (DialectBehavior.IndexedReadPreviousAfterOpenAtEnd, src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Runtime/IO/IndexedConnector.cs#SelectSequentialRecord) decides only which record §2002:14.8.29.3 GR18 selects for a READ PREVIOUS that is the first operation after OPEN on an indexed file. GR5 fixes the shape of the implied record area for READ INTO with no record description; which record fills it is GR18's. pb345 reads no PREVIOUS (grep). No change. Lead, not this row: at --std 2002 the switch returns the lowest record (probe prev-open-ix.cob: P1=K002|00) where §2002:14.8.26.3 GR12 (FPI = lowest-ordinal characters) with §2002:14.8.29.3 GR18c2 (key less than or equal to the FPI) find no record, so '10' and at end; that is a GR18 defect.
